entries.title: In Sound Mind
entries.definitive_edition: In Sound Mind Deluxe Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unity PC presentation with PC settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Deluxe Edition is the best route because it has the full game, PC capture/settings flexibility, and the available digital soundtrack/artbook extras without needing a lower-fidelity console route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy In Sound Mind Deluxe Edition on Steam or GOG and play the Windows PC build. Check for any display or input notes before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unity PC release with Deluxe Edition soundtrack/artbook extras available.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity/capture route and complete extras bundle.
skip: same core game, with no sourced exclusive gameplay content over the Windows PC Deluxe route.
skip: useful handheld/physical route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content and lower capture/fidelity priority than Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Deluxe extras are non-gameplay soundtrack/artbook content and are available on the PC route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or gameplay-complete edition beyond the Deluxe extras is documented.
